extracted.stage: Divorce proceedings, costs for counsel and forensic accountant
extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about a litigation loan of £31,000 to fund his client's divorce costs, with around £531,500 of property and pension assets in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court handling the proceedings, the stage reached and any listed hearing dates, and details of your client's position and circumstances. It would also help to have a breakdown of the assets in dispute and how they are held, together with your costs estimate to the next stage. We will send our criteria and application form and come back to you once we have reviewed the information provided. Please do let us know if anything material changes in the meantime.
